authority.readiness: OmniCreator agent work graph and canonical workflow state
authority.visual_route: canonical Studio Pack route plus available plugin/runtime capability

canonical_paths: visual_control provide_manual with truthful EXTERNAL_RESULT_IMPORT provenance for externally fetched image/video fallback
forbidden_paths: treating an ExternalGeneratedVisualRequestV1 descriptor as a Pexels stock request
committing stock video through the generated-still external result contract
downloading every search result before selection

generated.rule: use only when the prepared external descriptor is the generated-still contract

manual.rule: manual/external takeover remains valid when provider capability is unavailable

omnivoice_studio.rule: OmniVoiceStudio is an external renderer; canonical success exists only after OmniCreator accepts the result

manual.rule: manual audio plus timing remains valid when OmniVoiceStudio or compute is unavailable

concurrency.pexels: use bounded search/fetch workers and honor retry_after_seconds on provider rate limits
concurrency.omnivoice_studio: bound workers to the configured local/remote runtime capacity
concurrency.canonical_commit: serialize through the coordinator and Data Root writer lease

provenance.stock_external_fallback: EXTERNAL_RESULT_IMPORT with provider source_label such as pexels
provenance.voice_external: EXTERNAL_RESULT_IMPORT with source_label omnivoice-studio and prepared request_sha256
provenance.generated_external: EXTERNAL_RESULT_IMPORT with the prepared generated-visual request_sha256
provenance.never: convert provider failure or worker completion into canonical success

mixed_fallback: stock provider unavailable -> generated still when canonical route/approval permits, otherwise manual visual
generated provider unavailable -> manual/external supported still image
OmniVoiceStudio unavailable -> manual voice bundle with timing
rate limited -> preserve retryable failure, honor provider retry guidance, or choose an explicit fallback
